channel.title: The systemd project — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by The systemd project (systemd).

item.title: CVE-2026-15060 · 4.7 MEDIUM — systemd-machined: unprivileged users can terminate arbitrary processes
item.description: When systemd-machined >= v259 (or v258 with a custom `polkit` policy that allows `register-machine` access) is running on a desktop system, an unprivileged user logged in a desktop graphical session can kill arbitrary processes, even privileged ones.…

item.title: CVE-2026-16742 · 6.7 MEDIUM — systemd-homed: local privilege escalation via missing home-record signature verification on the authenticate path
item.description: systemd-homed contains a local privilege escalation bug via arbitrary system group addition to a local, logged in, homed-managed user

item.title: CVE-2026-15059 · 5.5 MEDIUM — systemd-oomd: unprivileged users can terminate arbitrary processes
item.description: Local unprivileged users can terminate arbitrary local processes via a systemd-oomd IPC API due to a missing path traversal validation.
